articles.title: In Netanyahu stronghold, signs of fraying loyalty emerge before election
articles.description: Although Kiryat Shmona remains staunchly conservative, there are rumblings of displeasure with Netanyahu’s handling of the latest war against the militant group Hezbollah, and that could bode poorly for him in Israel's election Tuesday.
